title: ClearPath Tenure Percentage on TimeBank Repeat Orders
content:
**Repeat-order tenure schedule.** For a repeat order of a TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours block, a client whose ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement is active at ClearPath Professional, ClearPath Premier or ClearPath Enterprise earns 1 percent for every full year since that agreement's go-live date, never more than 5 percent in all; a client whose ClearPath agreement is active at any other tier and went live at least 24 whole months before the order date earns a flat 2 percent; any other client earns no tenure percentage. The tenure percentage is a percentage granted to the repeat-order price.

**Counting.** Whole months and years are counted from the go-live date on the agreement's record to the order date, a month being complete only once the same day of the month is reached; a full year is twelve whole months.

| Active ClearPath tier | Service since go-live (hypothetical) | Tenure percentage |
|---|---|---|
| ClearPath Professional, Premier or Enterprise | 11 whole months | 0 |
| ClearPath Professional, Premier or Enterprise | 3 full years | 3 |
| ClearPath Professional, Premier or Enterprise | 8 full years | 5 (capped) |
| ClearPath Monitor, Essentials or Standard | 23 whole months | 0 |
| ClearPath Monitor, Essentials or Standard | 24 whole months | 2 |
| ClearPath Monitor, Essentials or Standard | 9 full years | 2 |
| no active ClearPath agreement | any | 0 |

Boundary case: an agreement that went live on 15 May earns its first full year on 15 May of the following year, not on 14 May.
